blocks.text: In the development phase the actual creation of the software begins. Programmers write the code, a set of instructions that the computer follows to perform specific tasks. Based on the design specifications, which outline what the software should do and how it should look, programmers translate these specifications into a programming language.

It is like following a recipe: the design specifications are the recipe and coding is mixing and baking the ingredients to make a cake; each line of code is a step in the recipe. During this phase programmers also test their code to find and fix errors or bugs; if issues are found they revise the code, correct the problems and test again until the software is ready for the next stage.
